note: 文言六维品藻（0–100）。后效＝客观遗产；月旦＝褒贬≠知名度。非正式史评。

axes.label: 国祚
axes.desc: 在位久暂与身后政权是否立得住

axes.label: 后效
axes.desc: 客观上留给后代的路径/制度

axes.label: 月旦
axes.desc: 世人与史评总体褒贬（高正低负）

qin-shi-huang.cry: 六合之内，皇帝之号始定。
qin-shi-huang.cry_en: Within the Six Directions, the title of Emperor is set for the first time.
qin-shi-huang.ability_en: Unified the six states; founded the commandery system.
qin-shi-huang.weakness_en: Harsh laws; dead in a generation.

han-wu-di.cry_en: Whoever offends mighty Han shall be punished, however distant.
han-wu-di.ability_en: Drove the Xiongnu north; exalted Confucianism alone.
han-wu-di.weakness_en: War without end; the witchcraft terror.

tang-tai-zong.cry_en: With Wei Zheng as my mirror, I know what was gained and lost.
tang-tai-zong.ability_en: Took remonstrance with an open heart; the four tribes came as guests.
tang-tai-zong.weakness_en: Blood at Xuanwu Gate; nothing gained in Liaodong.

sui-yang.stand_name_en: The Prince of Jin at Jiangdong
sui-yang.cry_en: The canal still runs; the brocade sails never return.
sui-yang.ability_en: Dug the canal to link the realm; opened exams to choose the talented.
sui-yang.weakness_en: Extravagance without limit; death for himself and his dynasty.

n-tang-houzhu.cry_en: In the bright moonlight, I cannot bear to look back on my lost kingdom.
n-tang-houzhu.ability_en: Opened new realms in the ci lyric; plain-sketch verse beyond compare.
n-tang-houzhu.weakness_en: State affairs wholly neglected; the Qianji poison did its work.

han-xuan-di.cry: 汉家自有制度，本以霸王道杂之。
han-xuan-di.cry_en: The House of Han has its own institutions — the ways of King and Hegemon, blended.
han-xuan-di.ability_en: Weighed names against deeds; restored the House of Han.
han-xuan-di.weakness_en: The Huo clan's shadow; an heir too soft.

xin-wang-mang.cry_en: Even the Duke of Zhou had days of dreading rumor.
xin-wang-mang.ability_en: King's-land to curb the estates; the Five Equalizations to aid the people.
xin-wang-mang.weakness_en: Names divorced from deeds; reform on reform till collapse.

e-han-guangwu.cry: 仕宦当作执金吾，娶妻当得阴丽华。
e-han-guangwu.cry_en: In office, be the Bearer of the Golden Mace; in marriage, win Yin Lihua.
e-han-guangwu.ability_en: A bamboo-split victory at Kunyang; the soft way that settled the realm.
e-han-guangwu.weakness_en: Land surveys vexed the people; prophecy muddled policy.

h-zhao-shi-le.cry: 大丈夫行事当礌礌落落，如日月皎然。
h-zhao-shi-le.cry_en: A true man acts in the open, towering and bright as sun and moon.
h-zhao-shi-le.ability_en: Decisive victory in the open field; order from the army's tent.
h-zhao-shi-le.weakness_en: Shi Hu cursed his heirs; the state died with the tyrant.

liang-wu.cry: 自我得之，自我失之，亦复何恨。
liang-wu.cry_en: I won it myself, I lost it myself — what is there to regret?
liang-wu.ability_en: Long years of civil rule; the Buddhist faith raised high.
liang-wu.weakness_en: Took in Hou Jing to his ruin; the starved of Tai City.

xixia-li-yuanhao.cry_en: Tangut and Han stand side by side — a realm of our own.
xixia-li-yuanhao.ability_en: Held Hexi like a lion; created the Tangut script.
xixia-li-yuanhao.weakness_en: Murdered in his own palace; torn between war and peace.

q-qin-fu-jian.cry: 以吾之众旅，投鞭于江，足断其流。
q-qin-fu-jian.cry_en: With an army like mine, cast our whips into the Yangtze and its flow is dammed.
q-qin-fu-jian.ability_en: All the Hu made one; the north swiftly unified.
q-qin-fu-jian.weakness_en: One rout at the Fei; every tribe in revolt.

n-wei-xiaowen.cry: 国家兴自北土，文轨未一，此用武之地，非可文治。
n-wei-xiaowen.cry_en: Our state rose from the northern soil, script and gauge not yet one; this is a land for arms, not for civil rule.
n-wei-xiaowen.ability_en: Moved the capital to Luoyang; remade the state in Han ways.
n-wei-xiaowen.weakness_en: Southern campaigns drained the state; the Six Garrisons smoldered.

sui-wen.cry: 混一戎夏，方为天子之事。
sui-wen.cry_en: To make Rong and Xia one — that is the business of the Son of Heaven.
sui-wen.ability_en: Made the empire one again; built the Kaihuang institutions.
sui-wen.weakness_en: Suspicion and harsh scrutiny; one fatal choice of heir.

zhou-wu-zetian.cry_en: Sun and moon over the empty sky — that is Zhao.
zhou-wu-zetian.ability_en: Paved the road to Kaiyuan; enlarged the Zhenguan legacy.
zhou-wu-zetian.weakness_en: Cruel inquisitors wove their nets; her legitimacy ever in doubt.

tang-xian-zong.cry: 淮西既平，藩镇稍知朝廷。
tang-xian-zong.cry_en: With Huaixi pacified, the provinces at last learned there is a court.
tang-xian-zong.ability_en: Cut down Huaixi; the Yuanhe restoration.
tang-xian-zong.weakness_en: Elixirs and a sudden death; his policies died with him.

zhou-shi.cry: 十年开拓天下，十年养百姓，十年致太平。
zhou-shi.cry_en: Ten years to win the realm, ten years to nourish the people, ten years to bring peace.
zhou-shi.ability_en: Drilled and roused the army; campaigned south and north.
zhou-shi.weakness_en: Cut off in his prime; his life's work took another's name.

n-song-tai-zu.cry: 卧榻之侧，岂容他人鼾睡。
n-song-tai-zu.stand_name_en: A Cup of Wine, Arms Laid Down
n-song-tai-zu.cry_en: How could I let another man snore beside my own couch?
n-song-tai-zu.ability_en: A cup of wine, arms laid down; strong trunk, weak branches.

yuan-shi-zu.cry_en: When cart-track and script are one, then you see the Great Unity.
yuan-shi-zu.ability_en: Founded the province system; the yam relay spanned the realm.
yuan-shi-zu.weakness_en: Campaigns without end; Han law and steppe way forever split.

n-wei-taiwu.cry: 扫统万，平秦陇，翦辽海，荡河源。
n-wei-taiwu.stand_name_en: Iron Cavalry of the True Lord
n-wei-taiwu.stand_type_en: The Iron Hoof of the North
n-wei-taiwu.cry_en: Sweep Tongwan, level Qin and Long, shear the Liao shores, scour the river's source.
n-wei-taiwu.ability_en: Iron cavalry, decisive victory; the north made one.
n-wei-taiwu.weakness_en: The Buddhist faith stamped out in blood; slain by his own eunuch.

han-hui-di.cry_en: The walls rose at Chang’an; power returned to the inner quarters.
han-hui-di.ability_en: Benevolent in keeping the peace; raised the walls of Chang’an.
han-hui-di.weakness_en: Too gentle, controlled by others; rule issued from the harem.

han-wen-di.cry: 露台百金，中人十家之产。
han-wen-di.cry_en: A hundred jin for a terrace is the estate of ten middle households.
han-wen-di.ability_en: Abolished cruel punishments, eased levies; frugality that restored Han.
han-wen-di.weakness_en: Heqin bent to the Xiongnu; feudatories left as a scourge.

han-jing-di.cry: 诛错兵不止，亚夫定七国。
han-jing-di.cry_en: Chao Cuo fell and the war did not stop; Zhou Yafu settled the Seven States in a season.
han-jing-di.ability_en: Quelled the revolt, trimmed the feudatories; eased flogging, lightened the law.
han-jing-di.weakness_en: Cold and ungrateful; wrongly destroyed his own ministers.

han-zhao-di.cry_en: The realm was drained; the people were rested.
han-zhao-di.ability_en: Lightened corvée, rested the people; saw through the conspiracy.
han-zhao-di.weakness_en: Died young; power fell to Huo Guang.

e-han-zhang.cry_en: His rule was broad and lenient; the name of elder-sage was his.
e-han-zhang.ability_en: Exalted Confucianism at White Tiger Hall; governed with breadth and lenience.
e-han-zhang.weakness_en: Indulged the Dou clan; consort kin grew arrogant.

han-qian-shao.cry_en: Four years of young emperors; power lived in the inner quarters.
han-qian-shao.ability_en: Succeeded to the line; raised by the Lü house.
han-qian-shao.weakness_en: A child with no support; slain in the palace.

han-hou-shao.cry_en: The empress dowager died; the Lü clan fell with her.
han-hou-shao.ability_en: Succeeded to the line; had no part in government.
han-hou-shao.weakness_en: Of doubtful standing; swept away in a morning.

han-changyi.cry: 立二十七日，废于二十七日。
han-changyi.cry_en: Enthroned for twenty-seven days, deposed on the twenty-seventh.
han-changyi.ability_en: Took the throne in succession; incapable in government.
han-changyi.weakness_en: Dissolute, deposed; name and person ruined.

han-yuan-di.cry_en: Gentle and fond of Confucian learning, irresolute to the end.
han-yuan-di.ability_en: Loved Confucianism and the classics; trimmed palace establishments.
han-yuan-di.weakness_en: Irresolute to a fault; Shi Xian seized power.

han-cheng-di.cry_en: The Zhaos disordered the inner court; the maternal kin ran the government.
han-cheng-di.ability_en: Deferred to his uncles; halted the Changling extravagance.
han-cheng-di.weakness_en: Sunk in wine and women; the Wangs ran the court.

han-ai-di.cry: 欲强主威，丁傅董贤乱之。
han-ai-di.cry_en: He would strengthen the throne; the Dings, Fus, and Dong Xian disordered it.
han-ai-di.ability_en: Dismissed the Three Excellencies; debated limits on land and houses.
han-ai-di.weakness_en: The Dong Xian infatuation; the Han mandate passing.

han-ping-di.cry_en: The annals record death; Mang’s biography tells of poison.
han-ping-di.ability_en: Succeeded to the line; a mere date in the annals.
han-ping-di.weakness_en: All policy from Wang Mang; a sudden death under suspicion.

han-ruzi.cry_en: An infant of two; the Han mandate ended.
han-ruzi.ability_en: A placeholder in the regency; awaited the abdication.
han-ruzi.weakness_en: An infant without power; life and death in others’ hands.

e-han-ming.cry: 后宫之家，不得封侯与政。
e-han-ming.stand_name_en: The Yongping Quest for the Dharma
e-han-ming.cry_en: No family of the inner palace may be enfeoffed or share in government.
e-han-ming.ability_en: Strict in law; the Yongping quest for the Dharma.
e-han-ming.weakness_en: The Chu-prince case spread wide; his severity overreached.

e-han-he.cry_en: The Yanran stone was carved; the eunuchs began their rise.
e-han-he.ability_en: Destroyed Dou Xian, ruled in person; Ban Chao settled the west.
e-han-he.weakness_en: The eunuchs' rise began; the consort cycle turned.

e-han-shang.cry_en: Not a hundred days old, and already on the throne.
e-han-shang.ability_en: Carried on the line; the Han house continued.
e-han-shang.weakness_en: On the throne in swaddling; dead in a season.

e-han-an.cry_en: A decade of Qiang war drained the treasury dry.
e-han-an.ability_en: Succeeded in Yongchu; lenient toward the commanderies.
e-han-an.weakness_en: His good name ended early; favorites disordered the rule.

e-han-shao-bei.cry_en: The Marquis of Beixiang died; Emperor Shun was raised on his fall.
e-han-shao-bei.ability_en: Reigned a few months; a date in the annals.
e-han-shao-bei.weakness_en: An infant dead suddenly; the Yans fell with him.

e-han-shun.cry_en: The eunuchs raised the sovereign; the Liangs followed them.
e-han-shun.ability_en: Ban Yong reopened the west; eight envoys toured the land.
e-han-shun.weakness_en: Power to the consorts; eunuchs enfeoffed.

e-han-chong.cry_en: One year of Yongjia; the Liangs held the state.
e-han-chong.ability_en: Carried on the line; the Han house endured.
e-han-chong.weakness_en: Enthroned in swaddling; dead in a year.

e-han-zhi.cry_en: The arrogant general; one word brought the poison.
e-han-zhi.ability_en: Sharp-witted in childhood; spoke his mind at court.
e-han-zhi.weakness_en: A word cost his life; the Liangs ran wild.

e-han-huan.cry_en: Liang Ji fell, the Five Marquises rose, and the proscription swept the land.
e-han-huan.ability_en: Borrowed the eunuchs' blade; swept away Liang Ji.
e-han-huan.weakness_en: The Five Marquises ruled; the proscription swelled.

e-han-ling.stand_name_en: Offices Sold at the West Garden
e-han-ling.cry_en: One cry of the Yellow Turbans, and the realm dissolved.
e-han-ling.ability_en: The Hongdu Academy; arts of calligraphy and letters.
e-han-ling.weakness_en: Offices sold for gold; eunuchs trusted in everything.

e-han-shao-bian.stand_name_en: Tragedy of the Prince of Hongnong
e-han-shao-bian.cry_en: Dong Zhuo made and unmade the throne; the Prince of Hongnong died of poison.
e-han-shao-bian.ability_en: Succeeded to the line; deposed without fault.
e-han-shao-bian.weakness_en: Tossed by the strongmen; poisoned at the grave's edge.

e-han-xian.cry_en: Four hundred years of the mandate, abdicated to Cao Pi.
e-han-xian.ability_en: Endured humiliation; kept his name whole.
e-han-xian.weakness_en: Government by the strongmen; a name without a state.

qin-zi-ying.cry_en: Forty-six days, and the altars of Qin were dust.
qin-zi-ying.ability_en: Slew Zhao Gao, steadied the crisis; took the seal in the final hour.
qin-zi-ying.weakness_en: His title was a form, his surrender left him friendless.

wei-wen.cry: 盖文章经国之大业，不朽之盛事。
wei-wen.cry_en: Literary composition is the great enterprise of statecraft, the glorious work of the imperishable.
wei-wen.ability_en: Founded a dynasty in letters; took the realm by abdication and fixed the tripod.
wei-wen.weakness_en: Harsh and ungenerous; the campaigns against Wu came to nothing.

wei-ming.cry: 沈毅好断，任意不恤下人。
wei-ming.cry_en: Resolute and self-assured, heedless of those beneath him.
wei-ming.ability_en: Held the west, subdued Liaodong; entrusted his heir in the final hour.
wei-ming.weakness_en: Built palaces to excess; his regency trust was the ruin of his house.

wei-qi.cry_en: The Gaopingling incident, and power passed to the Simas.
wei-qi.ability_en: Ascended a child and sat as a form of sovereignty.
wei-qi.weakness_en: Power passed to Sima's house; he was deposed and never returned.

wei-gaogui.cry: 司马昭之心，路人所知也。
wei-gaogui.cry_en: Sima Zhao's heart is known to every man on the road.
wei-gaogui.ability_en: Learned in the classics; unbowed in the final extremity.
wei-gaogui.weakness_en: Rushed the rising and fell beneath the southern gate.

wei-yuan.cry_en: The heavenly favor ended, and he abdicated to Jin.
wei-yuan.ability_en: Kept his place with obedience; ceded the realm with folded hands.
wei-yuan.weakness_en: The state's power was long lost; the altars passed to another house.

shu-zhaolie.cry: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为。
shu-zhaolie.cry_en: Do no evil because it is small; omit no good because it is small.
shu-zhaolie.ability_en: Won men by benevolence; allied with Sun to hold Cao at bay.
shu-zhaolie.weakness_en: Marched for righteousness and was shattered at Yiling.

shu-houzhu.cry_en: I am happy here, and do not think of Shu.
shu-houzhu.ability_en: Ruled well while he trusted the worthy; kept the throne forty years.
shu-houzhu.weakness_en: Heeded flatterers, governed idly, and surrendered with the seal in his mouth.

wu-da.cry_en: Without Gongjin, I should never have been emperor.
wu-da.ability_en: Raised the worthy, employed the able, and made Jiangdong a third of the realm.
wu-da.weakness_en: Erred twice in the succession; jealousy deepened with the years.

wu-kuaiji.cry_en: A child sovereign with strong ministers — he could not save himself.
wu-kuaiji.ability_en: Took the throne young and sat without effect.
wu-kuaiji.weakness_en: Strong ministers ruled; he was deposed and died in exile.

wu-jing.cry_en: He slew Sun Chen, founded the schools, and ruled by his own hand.
wu-jing.ability_en: Outplotted Sun Chen; founded academies and chairs of learning.
wu-jing.weakness_en: Harsh in punishment; his reign was brief.

wu-wucheng.cry_en: Bound bare, the coffin in his cart, and the fortunes of Wu were at an end.
wu-wucheng.ability_en: He governed in darkness and cruelty, and all men forsook him.
wu-wucheng.weakness_en: Slaughter and self-indulgence; he surrendered bound to Jin.

w-jin-wu.cry_en: Wang Jun's fleet came down, and the Wu sovereign surrendered bound.
w-jin-wu.ability_en: Unified the realm by Wu's conquest; fixed the rites and institutions.
w-jin-wu.weakness_en: Debauched, favored his wives' kin, and disbanded the armies to his realm's ruin.

w-jin-hui.stand_type_en: The Fool Who Lost the Realm
w-jin-hui.cry_en: Why do they not eat minced meat?
w-jin-hui.ability_en: Sat on the throne as a form while the princes fought.
w-jin-hui.weakness_en: Too dull to rule; the byword of the realm's ruin.

w-jin-huai.cry_en: Luoyang fell, and the officials died with it.
w-jin-huai.ability_en: A student of wide learning, he wished to restore the realm.
w-jin-huai.weakness_en: Bound by the strong minister; carried off to die at Pingyang.

w-jin-min.stand_name_en: The Last Chapter of Western Jin
w-jin-min.stand_type_en: Last Sovereign of the Fallen Realm
w-jin-min.cry_en: The coffin in his cart, he surrendered, and Chang'an was left in ruins.
w-jin-min.ability_en: Held the line at Chang'an as the realm crumbled.
w-jin-min.weakness_en: Guanzhong in waste, he surrendered to Liu Yao.

e-jin-yuan.stand_name_en: Wang and Sima Sharing the Realm
e-jin-yuan.cry_en: You and I share this realm.
e-jin-yuan.ability_en: Crossed south, founded the state, and kept it by frugality.
e-jin-yuan.weakness_en: Wanting in heroic measure, he was pressed by Wang Dun.

e-jin-ming.cry_en: He cut down the great villain, and Jiangdong was at peace.
e-jin-ming.ability_en: Slew the rebel minister and campaigned in person.
e-jin-ming.weakness_en: His reign was brief; the center was not yet firm.

e-jin-cheng.cry_en: Su Jun stormed the palace, and the emperor was carried off.
e-jin-cheng.ability_en: Ascended a child and left rule to his ministers.
e-jin-cheng.weakness_en: Su Jun's revolt took the palace and the emperor with it.

e-jin-kang.cry_en: Two years on the throne, the government still of the great clans.
e-jin-kang.ability_en: Succeeded his brother and held the throne quietly.
e-jin-kang.weakness_en: Died young, the government still in the clans hands.

e-jin-mu.cry_en: Huan Wen's expeditions shook the Central Plains.
e-jin-mu.ability_en: A child on the throne under the empress's regency.
e-jin-mu.weakness_en: Strong ministers ruled; the northern wars gained nothing lasting.

e-jin-ai.cry_en: Fasting and elixirs wasted him away.
e-jin-ai.ability_en: Succeeded to the throne and passed his years in quiet.

e-jin-fei.cry_en: The emperor was without great fault; Wen deposed him to awe the court.
e-jin-fei.ability_en: Held the throne quietly and without fault.
e-jin-fei.weakness_en: Huan Wen's defeat at Fangtou cost him the throne.

e-jin-jianwen.cry_en: Pure and passionless, a master of metaphysical talk.
e-jin-jianwen.ability_en: A conversationalist on the throne, quiet and self-possessed.
e-jin-jianwen.weakness_en: Bound by Huan Wen, he died of grief and vexation.

e-jin-xiaowu.stand_name_en: The Sovereign of the Fei River
e-jin-xiaowu.cry_en: Every grass and tree a soldier; the wind and cranes the enemy's cries.
e-jin-xiaowu.ability_en: Met Qin at the Fei River and saved the south.
e-jin-xiaowu.weakness_en: Lost to wine in his later years and slain in his palace.

e-jin-an.cry_en: He could not tell heat from cold, and all power went to the ministers.
e-jin-an.ability_en: Sat as a mere form of sovereignty.
e-jin-an.weakness_en: Dull beyond telling, he was strangled in the eastern hall.

e-jin-gong.cry_en: The fortunes of Jin were at an end, and he abdicated to Song.
e-jin-gong.ability_en: Yielded the throne and ended the line with grace.
e-jin-gong.weakness_en: A weak sovereign among strong ministers, he was done to death.

q-zhao-liu-yuan.cry_en: A Xiongnu heir who claimed the succession of Han.
q-zhao-liu-yuan.ability_en: Rose on the chaos and claimed the Han succession.
q-zhao-liu-yuan.weakness_en: Rose swiftly and fell swiftly; his heirs could not hold it.

q-zhao-liu-cong.stand_name_en: Taker of Luoyang, End of Jin
q-zhao-liu-cong.cry_en: Luoyang fell, and Emperor Huai was carried off.
q-zhao-liu-cong.ability_en: Took Luoyang and ended Western Jin.
q-zhao-liu-cong.weakness_en: Hunting and harem, tyranny and loss of virtue.

q-zhao-liu-yao.cry_en: Courage in plenty, counsel in short supply.
q-zhao-liu-yao.ability_en: Fixed the capital at Chang'an and furthered learning and instruments.
q-zhao-liu-yao.weakness_en: More brave than wise, he perished at Luoyang.

h-zhao-shi-hu.cry_en: A realm won by arms and lost by cruelty.
h-zhao-shi-hu.ability_en: Extended the realm and carried Later Zhao to its height.
h-zhao-shi-hu.weakness_en: Cruelty without limit, and ruin swift to follow.

cheng-han-li-xiong.cry_en: Tax and corvée both spared, and the people of Shu at peace.
cheng-han-li-xiong.ability_en: Ruled Shu gently with light levies.
cheng-han-li-xiong.weakness_en: Left the succession unsecured, and the realm declined.

q-yan-murong-huang.cry_en: He built Longcheng, and Liaodong grew strong.
q-yan-murong-huang.ability_en: Took the kingship and built up Liaodong.
q-yan-murong-huang.weakness_en: Distrusted his brothers; the house's wars began with him.

q-yan-murong-jun.cry_en: He took Ran Min's head and the throne, and held Ye in the Central Plains.
q-yan-murong-jun.ability_en: Destroyed Ran Wei, took the throne, and entered the Central Plains.
q-yan-murong-jun.weakness_en: Endless wars and a child heir.

q-qin-fu-jian-jian.cry_en: He cleared the land and held his walls, and Wen withdrew for want of grain.
q-qin-fu-jian-jian.ability_en: Took the pass, founded Qin, and denied Huan Wen.
q-qin-fu-jian-jian.weakness_en: Died young, and his cruel son Sheng followed.

h-qin-yao-chang.cry_en: He besieged Xinping and strangled his former lord.
h-qin-yao-chang.ability_en: Rose against Qin, slew Fu Jian, and founded a realm.
h-qin-yao-chang.weakness_en: Unfaithful to his lord, jealous and bloodthirsty.

h-qin-yao-xing.cry_en: Kumarajiva entered the pass, and the scriptures flourished.
h-qin-yao-xing.ability_en: United Guanzhong and furthered learning and translation.
h-qin-yao-xing.weakness_en: The succession unsecured, his last years in disorder.

h-yan-murong-chui.cry_en: One defeat at the Canhe marshes broke his fortunes.
h-yan-murong-chui.ability_en: The great general who restored the Yan line.
h-yan-murong-chui.weakness_en: The Canhe disaster and the unfinished campaign.

x-qin-qifu.cry_en: One corner at Yuanchuan, a rough founding, and an early end.
x-qin-qifu.ability_en: Held Yuanchuan and broke the neighboring tribes.
x-qin-qifu.weakness_en: Rough beginnings, brief years, a realm often cut off.

h-liang-lv-guang.stand_type_en: Strong in Arms, Weak in Rule
h-liang-lv-guang.cry_en: He broke Kucha and brought Kumarajiva home.
h-liang-lv-guang.ability_en: Conquered the Western Regions and held Liangzhou.
h-liang-lv-guang.weakness_en: The succession unsecured, his sons tearing the realm.

n-liang-tufa.cry_en: He fell from his horse, hurt his ribs, and the realm's years were few.
n-liang-tufa.ability_en: Turned from Liang and founded his kingship in Huangzhong.
n-liang-tufa.weakness_en: Rough beginnings and a death by drink.

n-liang-juqu.cry_en: He broke Dunhuang, and Western Liang perished.
n-liang-juqu.ability_en: Destroyed Western Liang and united Hexi.
n-liang-juqu.weakness_en: Slew his lord to rule, and distrusted his own kin.

x-liang-li-hao.cry_en: He founded the academy and urged the plough, and letters flourished.
x-liang-li-hao.ability_en: Founded schools, urged farming, and cared for the people.
x-liang-li-hao.weakness_en: Weak and cramped, destroyed by Northern Liang.

xia-helian.cry_en: He built Tongwan of steamed earth, and slew the builders for an awl's depth.
xia-helian.ability_en: Built Tongwan and seized Chang'an in the chaos.
xia-helian.weakness_en: Cruelty beyond measure, and the people's rage.

b-yan-feng-ba.cry_en: He lightened corvée and taxes and gathered the refugees.
b-yan-feng-ba.ability_en: Held Liaoxi and ruled it gently.
b-yan-feng-ba.weakness_en: Could not press onward; the succession fell into disorder.

q-liang-zhang-gui.cry_en: The Central Plains went under, and Liangzhou alone was at peace.
q-liang-zhang-gui.ability_en: Held the borders for Jin and carried his name through Hexi.
q-liang-zhang-gui.weakness_en: A self-made fief, and his heirs fell to internal war.

dai-shiyijian.cry_en: He made the laws and settled the land, and the north grew strong.
dai-shiyijian.ability_en: Made the laws, built the state, and strengthened the north.
dai-shiyijian.weakness_en: Destroyed by Qin; he died with his realm.

liu-song-wu.cry_en: He rose from the cloth, and took the realm by arms.
liu-song-wu.ability_en: Destroyed Later Qin by the northern expeditions and founded Song by abdication.
liu-song-wu.weakness_en: Jealous of his meritorious ministers, he slew many of them.

liu-song-shao.cry_en: He played endlessly and neglected government.
liu-song-shao.ability_en: Took the throne young and did nothing but play.
liu-song-shao.weakness_en: Neglected government and was deposed and slain.

liu-song-wen.cry_en: Yuanjia, in haste, sealed the Wolf's Head and gained a panic flight north.
liu-song-wen.ability_en: Brought the Yuanjia recovery, urging farming and learning.
liu-song-wen.weakness_en: Expeditions too hasty, and the succession brought his death.

liu-song-xiao.cry_en: He massacred Guangling, slaying all its men.
liu-song-xiao.ability_en: Won the throne by arms and put down the revolts.
liu-song-xiao.weakness_en: Built endlessly and crushed the people with levies.

liu-song-qianfei.cry_en: Eras changed thrice in a year, and court and realm trembled.
liu-song-qianfei.ability_en: Changed eras and slew princes and ministers without measure.
liu-song-qianfei.weakness_en: Depraved and lawless, he died in the Hualin Park.

liu-song-ming.stand_name_en: The Loss of the Huai North
liu-song-ming.cry_en: Kin slew kin, and the Huai north was lost.
liu-song-ming.ability_en: Won the civil war and ruled with letters and the brush.
liu-song-ming.weakness_en: Slaughtered his own kin and lost the Huai north.

liu-song-houfei.cry_en: A child on the throne, a doubtful state, the strong minister grown great.
liu-song-houfei.ability_en: Took the throne at ten with the power in his ministers.
liu-song-houfei.weakness_en: Played and slaughtered, and was slain by Xiao's men.

liu-song-shun.cry: 愿生生世世，不复生帝王家。
liu-song-shun.cry_en: In life after life, may I never be born into an imperial house.
liu-song-shun.ability_en: Sat the throne as a child and watched the realm pass.
liu-song-shun.weakness_en: Weak amid strong ministers, he was slain after the abdication.

qi-gao.cry: 十年治天下，黄金与土同价。
qi-gao.cry_en: Let me govern ten years, and gold shall be worth no more than earth.
qi-gao.ability_en: Pacified the realm, took the abdication, and ruled frugally.
qi-gao.weakness_en: His reign was brief, and his heirs lost the virtue.

qi-wu.cry_en: The people prospered, and the era was called Yongming.
qi-wu.ability_en: Brought the Yongming recovery and the people's plenty.
qi-wu.weakness_en: The north gained nothing, and the heir was untaught.

qi-yulin.cry_en: He gambled with money and played through the night.
qi-yulin.ability_en: Succeeded his grandfather and played without limit.
qi-yulin.weakness_en: Frivolous and worthless, he was deposed and slain.

qi-hailing.cry_en: Three changes in months, and the realm's power was gone.
qi-hailing.ability_en: Sat as a puppet and suffered the deposition.
qi-hailing.weakness_en: Deposed within months and soon done to death.

qi-ming.cry_en: Of the sons of Gao and Wu, none remained.
qi-ming.ability_en: Took the throne by deposition and kept the administration in order.
qi-ming.weakness_en: Slaughtered his kin — the poison of the house.

qi-donghun.cry_en: He paved the ground with gold lotus and made it bloom at every step.
qi-donghun.ability_en: He gave himself to luxury and slew his ministers.
qi-donghun.weakness_en: The golden lotus, and Jiankang fell.

qi-he.cry_en: The name of abdication masking the fact of usurpation.
qi-he.ability_en: Took the throne at Jiangling and watched the realm pass.
qi-he.weakness_en: A child figurehead, done to death after the abdication.

liang-jianwen.cry_en: Letters in plenty, but in the storm he could not rise.
liang-jianwen.ability_en: A poet of the palace style, elegant and refined.
liang-jianwen.weakness_en: Could not rise in the storm, and was slain by Hou Jing.

liang-yu.cry_en: Young, weak, powerless — not his own master.
liang-yu.ability_en: Set up as a child, at the mercy of the age.
liang-yu.weakness_en: Abdicated to Hou Jing and was done to death.

liang-yuan.cry_en: A hundred and forty thousand volumes, given to one flame.
liang-yuan.ability_en: Destroyed Hou Jing, took the throne, and gathered the books.
liang-yuan.weakness_en: Jealous of his kin, he lost Jiangling and the realm.

liang-jing.cry_en: A child in the storm, caught in the abdication.
liang-jing.ability_en: Sat the throne as a child and watched the realm pass.
liang-jing.weakness_en: Weak amid strong ministers, he was slain after the abdication.

chen-wu.cry_en: He destroyed Hou Jing, broke the Qi, and rebuilt the south of the river.
chen-wu.ability_en: Ended Hou Jing, broke the Qi armies, and founded Chen by abdication.
chen-wu.weakness_en: His reign was brief and the succession unsecured.

chen-wen.cry_en: He broke Wang Lin, fixed the borders, and brought the south modest plenty.
chen-wen.ability_en: Broke Wang Lin, settled the south, and governed it gently.
chen-wen.weakness_en: The northern border unsecured, and his years were few.

chen-fei.cry_en: Young and weak, the power with the Prince of Ancheng.
chen-fei.ability_en: Took the throne young with the government in his uncle's hands.
chen-fei.weakness_en: The power passed to his uncle, and he was deposed and died.

chen-xuan.cry_en: One defeat at Lüliang, and the Huainan was lost again.
chen-xuan.ability_en: Recovered the Huainan by the northern expedition — a moment of revival.
chen-xuan.weakness_en: Lost his army at Lüliang; the enterprise failed at the last.

chen-houzhu.stand_type_en: The Song of a Lost Realm
chen-houzhu.cry_en: The Jingyang well, and the rouge tears were spent.
chen-houzhu.ability_en: Raised the pavilions and wrote the verse of a lost realm.
chen-houzhu.weakness_en: Drowned in wine and women, and lost the realm.

n-wei-daowu.cry_en: One battle at the Canhe marshes, and the Yan host was buried.
n-wei-daowu.ability_en: Restored the state, founded Wei, and dissolved the tribes into a nation.
n-wei-daowu.weakness_en: Jealous and cruel in his last years, he was slain in the palace.

n-wei-mingyuan.cry_en: Yu destroyed Later Qin, and Wei took Henan.
n-wei-mingyuan.ability_en: Took the throne in the turmoil and carried the border to Henan.
n-wei-mingyuan.weakness_en: His reign was brief and the succession fixed too early.

n-wei-wencheng.cry_en: At Tanyao's plea, the caves of Wuzhou Mountain were opened.
n-wei-wencheng.ability_en: Restored the faith, calmed the people, and opened Yungang.
n-wei-wencheng.weakness_en: Weak in arms, and his years were few.

n-wei-xianwen.cry: 年十七而禅，慕浮屠之虚。
n-wei-xianwen.cry_en: Abdicated at seventeen, enamored of the Buddha's emptiness.
n-wei-xianwen.ability_en: Slew Yi Hun, ruled in person, and then withdrew.
n-wei-xianwen.weakness_en: Abdicated too early and died suddenly, the histories suspect.

n-wei-xuanwu.cry_en: A thousand monasteries, bells and stones answering each other.
n-wei-xuanwu.ability_en: Ruled in person and contended with Liang for the Huai.
n-wei-xuanwu.weakness_en: Doted on Buddhism and its temples; the succession was unsecured.

n-wei-xiaoming.cry_en: The Woye garrison rose, and the Wei house was near its fall.
n-wei-xiaoming.ability_en: Took the throne as a child under his mother's regency.
n-wei-xiaoming.weakness_en: The power was his mother's; his sudden death loosed the storm.

n-wei-xiaozhuang.cry_en: In the Mingguang Hall, his own hand against the strong minister.
n-wei-xiaozhuang.ability_en: Took the throne amid the Heyin massacre and slew Erzhu Rong.
n-wei-xiaozhuang.weakness_en: The strength did not match; he was slain at Jinyang.

n-wei-jemin.cry_en: He feigned deafness to escape, and could not escape in the end.
n-wei-jemin.ability_en: Hid by feigned deafness, then was set on the throne.
n-wei-jemin.weakness_en: The Erzhu's puppet, deposed and done to death.

n-wei-xiaowu.cry_en: One flight into the pass, and Wei split into east and west.
n-wei-xiaowu.ability_en: Set up by Gao Huan, he fled west to Chang'an.
n-wei-xiaowu.weakness_en: Bound by the strong ministers, he died by poison.

e-wei-xiaojing.cry: 聪慧好文，终为高氏所制。
e-wei-xiaojing.cry_en: Sharp and fond of letters, in the end the Gao house's captive.
e-wei-xiaojing.ability_en: Moved the capital to Ye and kept the sovereign's bearing.
e-wei-xiaojing.weakness_en: The Gao house's puppet, slain after the abdication.

w-wei-wen.cry_en: One victory at Shayuan, and Western Wei stood.
w-wei-wen.ability_en: Took the throne at Chang'an and reigned with folded hands.
w-wei-wen.weakness_en: Bound by the Yuwens, not his own master.

w-wei-fei.cry_en: He plotted against Tai, the plot leaked, and he died.
w-wei-fei.ability_en: Took the throne at Chang'an and would have stood alone.
w-wei-fei.weakness_en: The plot leaked; he was deposed and done to death.

w-wei-gong.stand_name_en: The Last Chapter of Western Wei
w-wei-gong.cry_en: He abdicated to Zhou, and Guanzhong changed masters.
w-wei-gong.ability_en: Took the throne by succession and watched the realm pass.
w-wei-gong.weakness_en: The power was the Yuwens'; he was slain after the abdication.

n-qi-wenxuan.cry_en: Clear in his first years, mad with wine in his last.
n-qi-wenxuan.ability_en: Founded Qi by abdication; built the Wall and extended the border.
n-qi-wenxuan.weakness_en: Slew in drunken madness — the histories condemn him utterly.

n-qi-fei.cry_en: Studious from youth, unable to hold his own.
n-qi-fei.ability_en: Studious and gentle, he reigned a single year.
n-qi-fei.weakness_en: Could not hold his own, and was deposed and slain.

n-qi-xiaozhao.cry: 明察俭约，欲革文宣之弊。
n-qi-xiaozhao.cry_en: Clear-sighted and frugal, set on repairing Wenxuan's evils.
n-qi-xiaozhao.ability_en: Took the throne by deposition and attended to government.
n-qi-xiaozhao.weakness_en: Fell from his horse on campaign and died in his year.

n-qi-wucheng.cry: 委任佞幸，齐政之衰自此始。
n-qi-wucheng.cry_en: He trusted flatterers, and the decline of Qi's government began here.
n-qi-wucheng.ability_en: Succeeded his brother and issued the statutes.
n-qi-wucheng.weakness_en: Debauched and trusting flatterers, the first step of Qi's decline.

n-qi-houzhu.cry_en: He played the song without sorrow, and the fortunes of Qi were at an end.
n-qi-houzhu.ability_en: The Sorrowless Sovereign, lost in his own music.
n-qi-houzhu.weakness_en: Slew Hulü Guang, and Qi fell swiftly.

n-zhou-xiao-min.cry_en: He took the heavenly kingship by abdication, and the minister slew him.
n-zhou-xiao-min.ability_en: Received the abdication as a child sovereign.
n-zhou-xiao-min.weakness_en: His plot leaked; he was deposed and slain.

n-zhou-ming.cry: 宽明仁厚，而见鸩于权臣。
n-zhou-ming.cry_en: Generous and kind, and poisoned by the strong minister.
n-zhou-ming.weakness_en: The power with the Duke of Jin, he died by poison.

n-zhou-wu.cry_en: He took Ye in person, and the north was one again.
n-zhou-wu.ability_en: Slew Yuwen Hu, ruled in person, and destroyed Qi to unite the north.
n-zhou-wu.weakness_en: Proscribed Buddhism and Daoism; his early death loosed the disaster.

n-zhou-xuan.cry_en: He compared himself to Heaven and slew without measure.
n-zhou-xuan.ability_en: Styled himself the Tianyuan Emperor and set up four empresses.
n-zhou-xuan.weakness_en: Extravagant and cruel, he let Yang Jian through the gap.

n-zhou-jing.cry_en: A child in the abdication, his life the foundation of Sui.
n-zhou-jing.ability_en: Sat the throne as a child and watched the realm pass.
n-zhou-jing.weakness_en: The power was Yang Jian's; he was slain after the abdication.

sui-gong.cry_en: Set up as a child, he abdicated to Tang.
sui-gong.ability_en: Set on the throne as a child, he watched the realm pass.
sui-gong.weakness_en: Grandson of Emperor Yang, he died soon after the abdication.

tang-gao-zu.cry_en: He rose at Taiyuan, and the Tang began.
tang-gao-zu.ability_en: Rose at Taiyuan and founded the Tang.
tang-gao-zu.weakness_en: The Xuanwu Gate; he ended as a yielded throne.

tang-gao-zong.cry_en: The Yonghui air, and the government passing to the inner palace.
tang-gao-zong.ability_en: Carried the Yonghui legacy; subdued Goguryeo and fixed the borders.
tang-gao-zong.weakness_en: His vertigo gave the government to Wu, who grew great.

tang-zhong-zong-a.cry_en: He would raise his wife's kin, and was deposed to Fangzhou.
tang-zhong-zong-a.ability_en: A month on the throne, the power with Empress Wu.
tang-zhong-zong-a.weakness_en: Raised his wife's kin recklessly and was deposed to Fangzhou.

tang-rui-zong-a.cry_en: Every matter decided by Wu, he was reduced to heir.
tang-rui-zong-a.ability_en: Sat as a puppet under Wu's regency.
tang-rui-zong-a.weakness_en: The government was Wu's; he was reduced to heir.

tang-zhong-zong-b.cry_en: Restored but unable to revive the court, he died within the palace.
tang-zhong-zong-b.ability_en: Restored by the Shenlong coup and returned the capital to Chang'an.
tang-zhong-zong-b.weakness_en: Empress Wei's slanted letters; he died suddenly in the palace.

tang-shang.cry_en: Empress Wei's choice, he yielded in the Tanglong coup.
tang-shang.ability_en: Set up by Empress Wei, he yielded within the month.
tang-shang.weakness_en: A child puppet, deposed at once.

tang-rui-zong-b.cry_en: He yielded to his worthy son — a good name in history.
tang-rui-zong-b.ability_en: Restored after Tanglong, he yielded to his worthy son.
tang-rui-zong-b.weakness_en: The princess ruled; twice a puppet.

tang-xuan-zong.weakness_en: Complacent in the Tianbao years, he loosed the An–Shi rebellion.

tang-su-zong.cry_en: The two capitals recovered, but Hebei unquiet.
tang-su-zong.ability_en: Took the throne at Lingwu and recovered the two capitals.
tang-su-zong.weakness_en: Hebei unsettled, and the palace in disorder.

tang-dai-zong.cry_en: The An–Shi rebellion ended, and the Heshuo was cut off.
tang-dai-zong.ability_en: Ended the rebellion and held the realm.
tang-dai-zong.weakness_en: Yuan Zai in power, and Buddhism adored beyond reason.

tang-de-zong.stand_type_en: The Broken Will to Cut the Feudatories
tang-de-zong.cry_en: Exiled at Fengtian, he returned by an edict of self-blame.
tang-de-zong.ability_en: Introduced the two-tax system and would have cut the feudatories.
tang-de-zong.weakness_en: The Fengtian exile, and suspicion and greed in his last years.

tang-shun-zong.cry_en: A hundred days of reform, the Two Kings and Eight Marshals.
tang-shun-zong.ability_en: Launched the Yongzhen reform, meaning to clear the abuses.
tang-shun-zong.weakness_en: Too ill to hold the throne; the reform unfinished.

tang-mu-zong.cry_en: The gains of Yuanhe, lost in a day.
tang-mu-zong.ability_en: Succeeded to the throne and played it away.
tang-mu-zong.weakness_en: Disbanding the armies misled the realm; Hebei rose again.

tang-jing-zong.cry_en: Home from the night hunt, he died by the eunuchs' hand.
tang-jing-zong.ability_en: A young sovereign who played without limit.
tang-jing-zong.weakness_en: A child at heart, slain by the eunuchs.

tang-wen-zong.stand_type_en: The Failed Strike at the Eunuchs
tang-wen-zong.cry_en: He would destroy his own servants, and was bound by them instead.
tang-wen-zong.ability_en: Frugal and scholarly, he meant to destroy the eunuchs.
tang-wen-zong.weakness_en: The Ganlu plot failed; he was bound by the eunuchs.

tang-wu-zong.cry: 任德裕而中兴，服丹药而暴崩。
tang-wu-zong.cry_en: With Deyu the revival; with the elixirs, the sudden death.
tang-wu-zong.ability_en: Brought the Huichang revival and destroyed Zelu.
tang-wu-zong.weakness_en: The persecution of Buddhism, and death by the elixirs.

tang-xuan-zong-ii.cry_en: Sharp in judgment, seeing all too clearly.
tang-xuan-zong-ii.ability_en: Brought the Dazhong recovery and judged sharply.
tang-xuan-zong-ii.weakness_en: Saw into everything; his chancellors did not last.

tang-yi-zong.cry: 迎佛骨而民怨，纵宴乐而政衰。
tang-yi-zong.cry_en: The relic welcomed and the people resentful; the feasting endless and the government failing.
tang-yi-zong.ability_en: Succeeded to the peace and spent it in pleasure.
tang-yi-zong.weakness_en: Extravagant and Buddhist-mad, he let the bandits flame up.

tang-xi-zong.cry_en: Huang Chao entered the capital, and the emperor fled again to Chengdu.
tang-xi-zong.ability_en: A child on the throne, the government with Tian Lingzi.
tang-xi-zong.weakness_en: Huang Chao took the capital, and the emperor fled to Shu.

tang-zhao-zong.cry_en: He had the will to restore, not the strength to turn the tide.
tang-zhao-zong.ability_en: Meant to restore the realm and tried again and again.
tang-zhao-zong.weakness_en: Ringed by the feudatories, taken to Luoyang and slain.

tang-ai-di.cry_en: The Baima drowning, and the abdication to Liang.
tang-ai-di.ability_en: A child on the abdicating throne, watching Tang die.
tang-ai-di.weakness_en: The Baimayi disaster, and death after the abdication.
